newsitem.title: USA: KeyCorp seen higher on restructuring news.
newsitem.headline: KeyCorp seen higher on restructuring news.

text.p: KeyCorp is expected to move higher Monday in response to an announcement of restructuring steps and a share repurchase plan, Wall Street analysts said.

Analyst Moshe Orenbuch of Sanford C. Bernstein Co said the plan to repurchase up to 12 milion shares by the end of 1997 was positive but had the restructuring not been coupled with the buyback, investors would have been more inclined to have a "wait and see attitude." He noted that KeyCorp has carried out other restructuring programs in the past.
Analyst Michael Plodwick of Salomon Brothers said KeyCorp shares could experience a "modest upside pop near term."
Asked if he anticipated any difficulty in KeyCorp achieving its objectives in the restructuring, he said, "There's no reason why it shouldn't. The specific targets appear to be reasonable."
Plodwick said he has been neutral to mildly positive on the stock.
KeyCorp was up 1-1/8 to 50 in early trading.
